speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, and do you have a history of autoimmune diseases?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any dark urine or pale, clay-colored stools, and do you have a history of heavy alcohol consumption or use of herbal supplements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results show a cholestatic pattern with elevated alkaline phosphatase, and the negative AMA makes primary biliary cholangitis unlikely. Given your history of ulcerative colitis, I suspect primary sclerosing cholangitis, so REQUEST IMAGES: MRCP.

speaker: Doctor
text: While we await the MRCP results to confirm the biliary anatomy, do you experience any right upper quadrant abdominal pain or fevers that might suggest an acute cholangitis episode? Also, have you noticed any significant unintentional weight loss or night sweats recently?
